items.title: Lew Soloff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: My father was in show business, and my mother was a violinist in Vaudeville. My father was a dancer and a comedian.

ctx.x: My father was in show business, and my mother was a violinist in Vaudeville. My father was a dancer and a comedian. And my whole family had a great sense of humor, and what’s left of it has. And I always loved the humor that Dizzy had in his playing, Clark [Terry] has a lot of humor in his playing, and to me humor and warmth kind of go together in a way.
